title: Single-shot on-chip measurement of the modal Stokes parameters
abstract: Integrated photonics has recently facilitated manipulating multimode partially coherent light in a compact mesh of Mach-Zehnder interferometers. A critical task in this context is on-chip reconstruction of the coherence matrix through a sequence of measurement configurations, thus giving rise to a speed bottleneck stemming from temporal delays in tuning on-chip phase shifts. Here we demonstrate single-shot reconstruction of the coherence matrix for two-mode partially coherent light by parallelizing the on-chip measurements of the modal Stokes parameters, thereby exchanging space for time. Although a larger chip area is required, the reconstruction is limited only by detection speed, thus potentially paving the way to real-time reconstruction of coherence matrices for applications in high-speed communications, cryptography, computation, and sensing.

summaries.en: The paper presents a single-shot on-chip method that parallelizes measurements of the modal Stokes parameters to reconstruct the coherence matrix of two-mode partially coherent light without sequential phase tuning, removing temporal-delay-induced speed bottlenecks for real-time prospects in communications and sensing.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种单次拍摄的片上方法，通过并行测量模态斯托克斯参数来重建两模部分相干光的相干矩阵，从而避免顺序相位调谐带来的时间延迟瓶颈，并有望实现用于通信、密码学、计算和传感的实时重建。

title: Phase matching of high-order harmonics driven by a combined coherent and bright squeezed vacuum field
abstract: High-order harmonic generation (HHG) driven by non-classical light provides new insights into light-matter interactions and paves the way to quantum attosecond spectroscopy. Achieving phase matching is vital for generating bright HHG sources, while it has received comparatively limited attention in quantum-light-driven HHG. In this work, we investigate the phase matching of HHG driven by an intense coherent field combined with a weak bright squeezed vacuum (BSV) field, using a semiclassical ensemble of coherent-field realizations sampled from the Husimi-$Q$ probability distribution. We reveal the physical mechanism behind the distinct pressure dependence of the harmonic yields for odd, even and half-integer sidebands spectral components, as observed in our previous experiment [ arXiv:2607.20941 ]. The simulations and phase-matching model demonstrate that the BSV-induced perturbation of the electron action phase could introduce an additional sub-cycle phase mismatch, such that the amplitude of sub-cycle bursts could be significantly modified by gas pressure after macroscopic propagation, even when the harmonic yield is near the optimum. The resulting amplitude asymmetry of sub-cycle bursts leads to a significant intensity contrast between half-integer sidebands harmonics, manifesting as distinct pressure dependence of their yields. Our findings reveal the phase-matching mechanism in two-color quantum-light-driven HHG, and suggest opportunities for macroscopic control of the non-classical HHG source.

summaries.en: The paper studies how phase matching in high-order harmonic generation changes when an intense coherent field is combined with a weak bright squeezed vacuum, using semiclassical ensembles sampled from the Husimi-Q distribution to explain pressure-dependent, parity- and half-integer-sideband yield behavior via an added sub-cycle phase mismatch induced by the squeezed vacuum.
summaries.zh: 本文研究了在强相干场与弱亮压缩真空（BSV）场叠加驱动高阶谐波产生时，相位匹配如何改变，并通过从 Husimi-Q 分布抽样的半经典相干场实现系综，解释奇、偶及半整数旁带谱分量的谐波产率随气体压强的差异，其核心机制在于BSV扰动引入了额外的亚周期相位失配，从而在宏观传播后显著调制亚周期脉冲并导致半整数旁带谐波出现明显强度对比及不同的压强依赖。

title: Theory of modulation instability for coupled microresonators
abstract: Thanks to hybridization phenomena, coupled microresonator systems enable modulation instability (MI) of the continuous wave background field across all possible dispersion combinations: anomalous-anomalous, normal-normal, and anomalous-normal microrings. Here, using the Lugiato-Lefever model in the supermode basis for two coupled microresonators with arbitrary second-order dispersion coefficients, arbitrary losses, and coupling strength, we derive a general eigenvalue problem for the $4\times 4$ matrix. We consider the regime of resonance splitting, in which the pump couples only to one of the two supermodes, allowing us to obtain analytical expressions for the stationary continuous-wave field distributed over the coupled system. When the microresonators have similar geometry, the antidiagonal elements of the eigenvalue-problem matrix nearly vanish, and we obtain a fully analytical solution for the MI gain rate for the entire range of coupled microresonator devices. Finally, we investigate cases in which the analytical treatment must be supplemented with more accurate numerical solutions of the MI eigenvalue problem, though even then the analytical theory captures the main features of the four-wave mixing process and the gain-rate behavior.

summaries.en: The paper develops an analytical theory of modulation instability in two coupled microresonators using the Lugiato–Lefever model in the supermode basis, deriving a general 4×4 eigenvalue problem that yields closed-form MI gain expressions across dispersion regimes (including anomalous–anomalous, normal–normal, and anomalous–normal) under resonance-splitting conditions and near-symmetric device geometry, while noting that numerical eigenvalue solutions may be needed for more complex cases but the analytic framework still reproduces the key four-wave-mixing features and gain behavior.
summaries.zh: 论文基于超模基下的拉吉亚托–莱费弗模型，提出了两耦合微谐振器中调制不稳定性的解析理论，推导出适用于任意二阶色散、损耗和耦合强度的4×4特征值问题，在共振分裂且泵只耦合到一个超模、并且器件几何相近使反对角项近似消失的条件下给出贯穿全部色散组合（异常-异常、正常-正常、异常-正常）的调制不稳定性增益率闭式解，并指出在更复杂情形下需用更精确的数值特征值求解补充，但解析理论仍能捕捉四波混频过程的主要特征及增益行为。

title: Mechanisms of turnkey soliton generation in self-injection-locked photonic-crystal ring resonators
abstract: Turnkey generation of dissipative Kerr solitons in photonic-crystal ring resonators relies on the interplay between engineered mode splitting, self-injection locking, and modulation instability, yet the mechanism governing soliton initiation and number selection remains incompletely understood. We investigate this interplay using coupled Lugiato-Lefever equations with a self-consistent nonlinear self-injection-locking condition. Analysis of continuous-wave steady states and their locking stability reveals operating points accessible through feedback-induced transitions between split resonances. Evaluating modulation-instability gain at these points identifies conditions for comb initiation and links the dominant unstable sideband modes to soliton-number selectivity. Direct time-domain simulations corroborate the analysis, showing that appropriately chosen mode splitting enables highly repeatable single-soliton generation without external laser-frequency scans. The final soliton number is nevertheless shaped by subsequent nonlinear evolution and feedback-induced detuning changes, rather than by the initial instability alone. We also show that larger dispersion suppresses higher-order unstable modes and favors lower soliton numbers.

summaries.en: The paper uses coupled Lugiato–Lefever equations with self-consistent self-injection locking to show how engineered mode splitting and modulation-instability jointly determine comb initiation and soliton-number selectivity in photonic-crystal ring resonators, enabling repeatable turnkey single-soliton generation while also finding that the final soliton number is further set by later nonlinear evolution and feedback-induced detuning changes and that larger dispersion suppresses higher-order unstable modes and favors lower soliton numbers.
summaries.zh: 论文基于带自洽自注入锁定条件的耦合Lugiato–Lefever方程，说明在光子晶体环形谐振器中，工程化的模分裂与调制不稳定性如何共同决定梳状谱起振与孤子数选择，从而实现无需外部激光频率扫描的高度可重复“即插即用”单孤子产生，并进一步指出最终孤子数主要由后续非线性演化及反馈诱导的失谐变化共同塑形，同时更大的色散会抑制高阶不稳定模、并倾向于获得更低的孤子数。

title: Temporal Soliton Waves in Modern Fiber Laser Systems
abstract: This chapter provides a comprehensive survey of temporal soliton-wave in modern fiber systems. Temporal soliton waves constitute a broad class of nonlinear localized structures in modern fiber laser systems, arising from different balances among dispersion, nonlinearity, gain, loss, spectral filtering, and various forms of cavity coupling. We review the underlying theory, basic experimental findings, and practical methods for the generation, real-time characterization, and active control of soliton families, with a particular focus on recent progress reported for mode-locked fiber-laser platforms. The families covered in the chapter include dissipative solitons, soliton molecules (bound states), and dispersion-managed solitons. For each species, we focus on the pulse energy, duration, stationary and breathing states, and emerging intelligent (machine-learning-assisted) control strategies.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Pattern Formation and Solitons (nlin.PS); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The chapter surveys temporal soliton waves in modern fiber laser systems, covering their theory, key experiments, and methods for generating, characterizing, and actively controlling soliton families—especially in mode-locked fiber lasers—by focusing on dissipative solitons, soliton molecules, and dispersion-managed solitons and on pulse energy, duration, stationary/breathing dynamics, and emerging machine-learning-assisted control.
summaries.zh: 本章系统综述现代光纤激光系统中的时间孤子波，阐述其理论基础、关键实验结果以及用于生成、实时表征和主动控制不同孤子族的方法，并重点关注锁模光纤激光平台的最新进展，内容涵盖耗散孤子、孤子分子（束缚态）与色散管理孤子，重点分析脉冲能量、脉宽、稳态与呼吸态动力学及新兴的智能（机器学习辅助）控制策略。

title: Competing Symmetry Breakings and Spontaneous Parity Restoration in Desynchronously Pumped Kerr Resonators
abstract: Symmetry breaking is a cornerstone of nonlinear science, where stronger driving typically compounds parity loss across coupled degrees of freedom. Here, we uncover a counterintuitive symmetry-restoring transition driven by the competition between internal spontaneous polarization symmetry breaking (PSB) and external explicit temporal symmetry breaking (TSB) in desynchronously pumped Kerr resonators. Tuning pump-cavity desynchronization steers dissipative cavity solitons from pure PSB, through a robust hybrid symmetry-breaking (HSB) regime where both asymmetries coexist, into a pure TSB state accompanied by the abrupt, spontaneous restoration of polarization parity. Using collective-coordinate perturbation theory, we map the effective Ginzburg-Landau potential landscape and show that kinematic drift weakens local driving until a saddle-node bifurcation eliminates the temporal confining barrier. Corroborated by full Ikeda-map simulations across the phase boundary, our results demonstrate how driven-dissipative systems sacrifice internal order to satisfy external kinematic constraints, offering a general paradigm for competing order parameters in multidimensional nonlinear systems.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in desynchronously pumped Kerr resonators, tuning pump–cavity desynchronization can counterintuitively restore polarization parity by driving a transition from internal spontaneous polarization symmetry breaking through a hybrid coexistence regime to a purely temporally symmetry-broken state, explained via collective-coordinate modeling and verified by Ikeda-map simulations.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在去同步泵浦的Kerr谐振器中，通过调节泵—腔失同步性，可出现反直觉的偏振宇称恢复转变：系统从内部自发偏振对称性破缺出发，经“混合对称性破缺”（两类破缺共存）的稳健区，最终进入纯时间对称性破缺态，并借助集体坐标微扰理论（有效Ginzburg–Landau势景观、鞍结分岔消除时间约束势垒）及Ikeda映射全仿真验证该机制。

title: Tweezing microparticles by tightly focused optical skyrmionic fields
abstract: The concept of skyrmions, once translated to the optical domain, provides a topological framework to investigate structured light-matter interactions. However, their practical use for the manipulation of material systems remains barely explored. Here, we experimentally demonstrate trapping and tunable orbital motion of dielectric microparticles in tightly focused skyrmionic polarization textures prepared using a compact spin-orbit optical element. We explore the tweezing capabilities at fixed topology either by varying the relative weights of the orthogonally polarized components or by switching between skyrmion and bimeron polarization textures. Vectorial focusing and optical-force calculations qualitatively reproduce the experimental observations. These results motivate extending skyrmionic light to the manipulation of micro-objects, including birefringent and chiral samples.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally demonstrates that tightly focused optical skyrmionic polarization textures, generated with a compact spin-orbit element, can trap dielectric microparticles and provide controllable orbital motion, with observations supported by vectorial focusing and optical-force calculations and enabled by tuning component weights or switching between skyrmion and bimeron topologies.
summaries.zh: 论文实验表明，借助紧聚焦的光学斯格明子（skyrmion）偏振纹理（由紧凑的自旋-轨道光学元件产生）能够俘获介电微粒并实现可调的轨道运动；通过改变正交偏振分量的相对权重或在斯格明子与双极子（bimeron）偏振纹理之间切换来实现固定拓扑下的操控，并以矢量聚焦与光学力计算对实验现象进行定性复现，结果也展望将斯格明子光扩展用于操控双折射与手性样品。

title: Toward light-controlled transverse Wigner ordering in attosecond electron beams
abstract: Kinetic fluctuations and space-charge expansion hinder Wigner ordering in free-electron beams. Here we propose a laser-driven route toward transient, substrate-free Wigner ordering that combines photon-induced near-field electron microscopy (PINEM) attosecond bunching, synchronized magnetic focusing, and spatial preconditioning. Classical relaxation and zero-temperature fixed-node diffusion Monte Carlo trap benchmarks show that sixfold order survives quantum fluctuations from 1 T to sub-Tesla fields, defining ultrafast preparation targets.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a laser-driven scheme to achieve transient, substrate-free transverse Wigner ordering in attosecond electron beams by combining PINEM-based bunching, synchronized magnetic focusing, and spatial preconditioning, with simulations showing robust sixfold order across 1-T to sub-Tesla fields despite quantum fluctuations.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种利用PINEM实现的阿秒束团化、同步磁聚焦以及空间预调制的激光驱动方案，以在不依赖衬底的情况下在横向获得短暂的Wigner有序，并通过经典弛豫与零温固定结点扩散蒙特卡洛的对照基准表明六重有序可在1 T到亚特斯拉范围内抵抗量子涨落而保持。

title: Quantum Tautochrone for photons and atoms
abstract: The tautochrone problem, in which the travel time to a common point is independent of the starting position, has served as a foundational model in classical mechanics. Here we establish its quantum counterpart in engineered photonic waveguide arrays and atomic optical lattices, where nonuniform couplings drive photons and particles launched from different positions to converge simultaneously at a common site. Using higher-order correlation functions, we show that this quantum tautochrone effect holds for both bosons and fermions, with quantum statistics governing the character of the convergence: bosons converge onto the same site, while fermions, constrained by Pauli exclusion, gather at neighboring sites. For bosonic atoms, we further show how the tautochrone dynamics is shaped by lattice inhomogeneity, phase-space structure, and on-site interactions.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and demonstrates a quantum version of the tautochrone problem in engineered photonic waveguide arrays and atomic optical lattices, showing that nonuniform couplings make bosonic and fermionic excitations launched from different positions arrive simultaneously, with bosons bunching at one site while fermions populate neighboring sites due to quantum statistics and constraints, and it analyzes how inhomogeneity, phase-space structure, and on-site interactions affect bosonic atomic dynamics.
summaries.zh: 本文在工程化光子波导阵列与原子光学晶格中建立并验证了“量子涛时钟”问题的量子对应物：通过非均匀耦合使得从不同初始位置出发的玻色与费米激发能同时汇聚到同一目标位点；利用高阶关联函数表明，量子统计决定汇聚特征——玻色子受同位聚集效应驱动在同一位点聚集，而费米子因泡利不相容而只能聚集到相邻位点，并进一步分析玻色原子中晶格非均匀性、相空间结构与在位相互作用对动力学的影响。

title: Dynamic tuning of anisotropy-induced quasi-bound-states-in-the-continuum in liquid-crystal integrated dielectric metasurfaces
abstract: Symmetry-protected quasi-bound states in the continuum (qBICs) in all-dielectric metasurfaces can be excited either by introducing a geometrical asymmetry into the unit cell or by illuminating the metasurface under oblique incidence. To date, tuning the coupling strength of such qBICs to the continuum has mainly relied on control of the geometrical asymmetry. Here, we show that qBICs can also be induced in a symmetric dielectric metasurface by embedding the latter into an anisotropic birefringent medium, and that they can be actively tuned by either rotating the anisotropy axis of the medium or by varying the degree of anisotropy. We experimentally implement a corresponding system by embedding a highly symmetric silicon nanocylinder metasurface into a nematic liquid crystal (LC) cell. Importantly, the LC does not only provide the desired birefringence, but also dynamic control of its strength as well as of the orientation of its anisotropy axis in response to different external stimuli. Specifically, applying voltage across the LC cell, where the LC molecules are pre-aligned along one of the lattice directions of the metasurface, enables out-of-plane rotation of the anisotropy axis of the LC medium. Meanwhile, its birefringence can be tuned by changing the temperature. In our experiments, the coupling of the qBICs to the radiation continuum is first maximized by the application of 25 V across the LC cell at room temperature. We then systematically tune the temperature and show that the resonance depth of the qBIC modes, which is associated with their coupling strength to the continuum, of the qBIC modes increases monotonously with birefringence. Our findings establish anisotropy-induced qBICs in LC integrated dielectric metasurfaces as a promising platform for actively reconfigurable metasurfaces and their applications in displays, optical modulation and tunable photonic devices.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that symmetry-protected quasi-bound states in the continuum in an otherwise symmetric dielectric metasurface can be induced and dynamically tuned by embedding the metasurface in a birefringent anisotropic medium using liquid-crystal control of anisotropy strength and axis orientation, experimentally validating monotonic tuning of qBIC resonance depth with birefringence.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在保持对称的介电超表面中引入各向异性双折射介质即可诱导并通过液晶动态调控各向异性强度及轴向取向来调节连续体中的准束缚态（qBIC），其实验结果验证qBIC模的共振深度随双折射率单调增加，并指出该平台有望用于可重构超表面及显示、光学调制和可调光子器件等应用。

title: Propagation-tunable fractional Stokes skyrmions in conical refraction
abstract: Conical refraction in a biaxial crystal generates Stokes textures whose finite-domain skyrmion number takes fractional values tunable through free-space propagation, while the underlying azimuthal winding remains unchanged. For a circularly polarised Gaussian input, the skyrmion number is governed by the boundary Stokes parameter, $N_\mathrm{sk}=[1-s_3(R_\mathrm{cut},Z)]/2$. Six-state polarimetry reveals fractional values of 0.523, 0.565 and 0.266 in the Lloyd, Poggendorff and Raman regions, respectively, in close agreement with Belsky-Khapalyuk-Berry predictions of 0.530, 0.550 and 0.250, and reproduces the predicted longitudinal evolution. Conical refraction thus provides a passive route to propagation-tunable fractional Stokes skyrmions, in which continuously evolving polarisation geometry coexists with a fixed topological winding.

summaries.en: The paper shows that conical refraction in a biaxial crystal produces fractional, propagation-tunable Stokes skyrmion numbers—set by the boundary Stokes parameter—while keeping the azimuthal winding fixed, confirmed by six-state polarimetry and matching Belsky-Khapalyuk-Berry predictions across Lloyd, Poggendorff, and Raman regions.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在双轴晶体中的锥形折射会生成分数量子斯托克斯涡旋（skyrmion）的数值，并可通过自由空间传播连续调谐其大小，且保持方位角缠绕不变；该结论通过六态偏振测量得到验证，并与Belsky-Khapalyuk-Berry预测在Lloyd、Poggendorff和Raman区域的结果及其纵向演化相一致。

title: A library-based approach for inverse reconstruction of cavity depth using angle-resolved cathodoluminescence
abstract: In nanofabrication processes, accurate metrology is a crucial step for obtaining control over the required critical dimensions in a device. Traditionally, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) is used to obtain high resolution measurements of the lateral dimension, but obtaining depth information on a thick sample is more complex. In this work, we use angle-resolved cathodoluminescence (AR-CL) spectroscopy to resolve this third dimension. Using 30 keV electrons in the SEM, CL is created at the bottom of a micrometer scale cavity milled in a gold surface. We show that reflections of the CL off the cavity sidewalls produce an interferogram which is a sensitive probe for the cavity geometry. The interferograms can be modelled using the finite-difference time-domain method, and we demonstrate that a neural network trained on a library of these simulated patterns can be used to reconstruct the cavity depth. This approach establishes a proof of concept for AR-CL based depth reconstruction within a prescribed geometry and could form a route towards advanced three-dimensional metrology of complex nanostructures.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a proof-of-concept method for reconstructing micrometer-scale cavity depth from angle-resolved cathodoluminescence interferograms by training a neural network on a library of finite-difference time-domain simulations using 30 keV SEM-generated CL signals reflected from cavity sidewalls.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种利用角分辨阴极发光（AR-CL）干涉图重建微米尺度腔深度的方法：用30 keV在SEM中激发的发光信号经腔侧壁反射形成干涉条纹，并通过基于有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真图样训练神经网络来完成深度反演，从而实现复杂纳结构的三维计量的可行性验证。

title: Nonreciprocal state-selective splitting of eigenstates at a polarization exceptional point
abstract: Non-Hermitian photonic systems can be engineered to exhibit exceptional points (EPs), where eigenvalues and eigenstates coalesce. Although perturbations near EPs have mainly been characterized through eigenvalue splitting, the branch-resolved evolution of the coalesced eigenstates under a tunable reciprocity-breaking perturbation remains less systematically explored. Here, we show that tunable nonreciprocal coupling can produce state-selective splitting of the coalesced eigenstates near a second-order polarization EP. Using temporal coupled-mode theory, we find that the corresponding off-diagonal perturbation produces a triangular Hamiltonian in the circular-polarization basis. In the ideal limit, one eigenstate remains pinned to the EP state, whereas the other is continuously reoriented by the perturbation. In a realistic scattering system, residual reverse-polarization conversion weakly displaces the nominally pinned branch, resulting in quasi-pinning. We numerically demonstrate this mechanism in a reflective magneto-optical metasurface supporting a circular-polarization EP of the reflection matrix near 582 nm. Full-wave simulations show that a perpendicular magneto-optical bias leaves one reflection eigenstate close to the EP state while reversibly displacing the other on the Poincare sphere. This asymmetric eigenstate evolution manifests as a magnetically tunable circular-dichroic reflection response. Our results establish a nonreciprocal route to state-selective eigenstate control near polarization EPs.

summaries.en: The paper shows that a tunable nonreciprocity-breaking perturbation near a second-order polarization exceptional point can cause state-selective (one pinned, one reoriented) splitting of coalesced eigenstates, forming a triangular Hamiltonian in the circular-polarization basis and producing a magnetically tunable circular-dichroic reflection response in a magneto-optical metasurface near 582 nm.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，在二阶偏振例外点附近，通过可调的破坏互易性的扰动可以实现共聚特征态的态选择性分裂（一个“钉扎”在例外点附近，另一个被连续重新定向），该扰动在圆偏振基底中对应三角形哈密顿量，并在约582 nm的磁光超表面中实现可磁调谐的圆二色反射响应。

title: AI-Assisted Topological High-Harmonic Spectroscopy for Characterizing Crystal Symmetries and Nonlinear Responses
abstract: Structured light has emerged as a unique tool for probing nonlinear light-matter interactions. Particularly interesting is its interaction with anisotropic media, such as crystalline materials, whose anisotropic responses encode information about their electronic properties. Recently, topological high-harmonic spectroscopy was introduced as an all-optical approach to extract the anisotropic nonlinear response of graphene from harmonic spatial intensity profiles. Here, topological high-harmonic spectroscopy is combined with artificial intelligence (AI) to retrieve the anisotropic non-linear response and crystal symmetry of atomically thin materials. A convolutional neural network is trained and validated to learn the inverse mapping between harmonic far-field intensity profiles and the nonlinear response of materials exhibiting different rotational symmetries. Comparisons with microscopic high-harmonic-generation simulations demonstrate the accurate retrieval of distinct effective nonlinear responses in single-symmetry crystals, such as single-layer graphene and bilayer graphene with different stacking orders, and in crystals exhibiting multiple symmetry components, such as monolayer hexagonal boron nitride. Macroscopic high-harmonic-generation simulations assess the robustness and applicability limits of the technique. These results establish AI-assisted topological high-harmonic spectroscopy as a fast, contactless tool for characterizing nonlinear optical responses and crystal symmetries without phase-resolved measurements, opening prospects for applications to complex systems such as polycrystals and van der Waals heterostructures.

summaries.en: The paper presents an AI-assisted version of topological high-harmonic spectroscopy that uses convolutional neural networks to infer a material’s anisotropic nonlinear optical response and crystal symmetry from harmonic far-field intensity profiles, validated against microscopic and macroscopic high-harmonic-generation simulations for graphene, bilayer stacking variants, and hexagonal boron nitride.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种结合人工智能的拓扑高次谐波光谱方法，通过卷积神经网络从谐波远场强度分布中反演材料的各向异性非线性光学响应与晶体对称性，并通过微观与宏观高次谐波产生仿真验证了其在单层/双层石墨烯不同堆垛以及六方氮化硼等体系中的准确性与适用边界。

title: Heat Reduction in Erbium-Doped Microresonator
abstract: We investigate anti-Stokes fluorescence in a 106-micrometer-diameter silica whispering-gallery-mode microresonator coated with erbium-doped sol-gel, assessing its potential for reduced optical heating. Near-infrared fluorescence spectra acquired under pulsed excitation near 1.55 micrometers exhibit a mean emitted photon energy above the pump photon energy. Measurements over a temperature range of 25 to 62 degrees Celsius show that the mean fluorescence photon energy increases with externally controlled temperature. The measured pump-wavelength dependence is consistent with an absorption-weighted spectral model, which predicts an optimum near 1562.65 nm for the investigated spectral figure of merit. Resonance-dependent emission patterns further motivate a dual-frequency pumping scheme using two higher-order whispering-gallery modes. Calculated time-averaged field profiles indicate that complementary modal distributions can provide more uniform excitation near the equator. These results characterize spectral conditions relevant to fluorescence-based heat reduction and suggest a route toward improved spatial pump coverage. Demonstrating net optical refrigeration requires additional measurements of absorbed pump power and an independent thermal readout.

summaries.en: The paper studies anti-Stokes fluorescence from a 106-µm silica whispering-gallery microresonator coated with erbium-doped sol-gel, showing that the mean emitted photon energy exceeds the pump energy and increases with temperature, with wavelength behavior explained by an absorption-weighted model predicting an optimum near 1562.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了在一台涂覆铒掺杂溶胶-凝胶的106微米口径二氧化硅环形微腔中由反斯托克斯荧光实现的降热潜力，结果表明在接近1.

title: Packing the Bragg sphere: complete three-dimensional photonic band gaps at the refractive index of polymers (1.55)
abstract: Complete 3D photonic band gaps have so far been found only at refractive-index contrasts of about 1.9 and above, reached by rod-connected diamond lattice structures. Reciprocal-space design of quasiperiodic structures recently achieved considerable emission attenuation at much lower contrasts [L. Maiwald et al., Adv. Optical Mater. 10, 2100785 (2022)]. Here we implement systematic search and reciprocal-space design of periodic 3D structures with complete band gaps, solving a discrete optimization problem on an integer lattice. A gap above a high band needs the strongest Fourier components of the dielectric close to the Bragg sphere of that band. Crystals with large cells, started from Fourier peaks at the vertices of a polyhedron on this sphere and optimized against densely refined band edges, open complete gaps down to an index contrast of 1.55, that of common polymers against air. A rational approximant of an icosidodecahedron gave the most efficient location of the Fourier peaks among the polyhedra tested. Numerical calculations confirm the gaps over a resolution series, with band edges searched over the whole Brillouin zone. The best designs are connected porous networks, suited to a microwave test with printed polymer. A rigorous bound, valid for any structure, does not exclude gaps at lower index, and the next rational approximants of the icosidodecahedron, whose Bragg zones match bands 576 and 2440 almost exactly, point to where gaps at even lower contrast may be sought.

summaries.en: The paper uses reciprocal-space, discrete integer-lattice optimization to design periodic 3D photonic crystals with complete band gaps down to a refractive-index contrast of 1.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在倒易空间中对整数晶格进行离散优化，设计出可在聚合物对空气的折射率对比度低至1.

title: Recipe for near-unity efficient frequency conversion via transient molecular modulation
abstract: Frequency transduction technologies are an essential element for interfacing devices operating at distinct spectral regions. Specifically, the conversion of weak signals between different wavelengths is a fundamental requirement of quantum networks, where conversion efficiency is critical for preserving the statistical properties of light. In this regard, molecular modulation in gas-filled hollow-core fibers offers a promising approach for highly-tunable linear frequency conversion of classical and quantum light. However, recent experimental studies in this subject have struggled to overcome a saturation in conversion efficiency to about 70%, which, although high, might impair the faithful transfer of quantum properties upon conversion. In this work, we discuss a route to surpass this limitation that identifies the key factors to consider for obtaining quantum efficiencies exceeding 99%. These results might pave the way to viable fiber-based quantum transduction schemes for next-generation quantum networks.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and analyzes how transient molecular modulation in gas-filled hollow-core fibers can enable near-unity (>99%) frequency conversion efficiency for classical and quantum light, overcoming an observed ~70% saturation that could otherwise hinder faithful quantum-state transfer.
summaries.zh: 本文提出并分析了在充气的中空芯光纤中利用瞬态分子调制实现近乎100%（>99%）的频率转换效率的方法，从而突破此前实验中约70%的转换效率饱和，该饱和可能会阻碍量子态在转换过程中的忠实传递。

title: Integrated lasing and dual-band gain in neodymium-implanted silicon nitride
abstract: Lasers at wavelengths near 1 micrometer are used in quantum technologies, precision metrology, and sensing. Rare-earth gain at these wavelengths in photonic integrated circuits can reduce the size and enable the scalable fabrication of these lasers. We fabricate neodymium-based integrated waveguide amplifiers and a ring laser using neodymium-implanted LPCVD silicon nitride. The photonic integrated circuits were fabricated on a 200 mm commercial wafer platform, and individual dies were implanted with neodymium ions. We show that the amplifiers provide gain in two bands around wavelengths of 920 nm and 1100 nm, and we show lasing in a ring resonator. This demonstrates that neodymium-implanted LPCVD silicon nitride is a suitable gain material for integrated lasers.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates neodymium-implanted LPCVD silicon nitride photonic integrated circuits that provide dual-band amplification near 920 nm and 1100 nm and enable ring-resonator lasing on a 200 mm wafer platform.
summaries.zh: 论文展示了将钕离子注入LPCVD硅氮光子集成电路后可在约920 nm和1100 nm实现双波段放大，并在200 mm晶圆平台上实现环形谐振腔激光，从而证明该材料适合作为集成激光增益材料。

title: Ultra-Wideband Stacked Patch Antenna for D-Band Applications
abstract: This article proposes a wideband stacked dual-patch antenna designed for D-band applications. The antenna is demonstrated with both wireless and dielectric waveguide (DWG) channels. The patch dimensions and spacings are chosen to ensure that the $10~dB$ return loss (RL) bandwidth covers the entire D-band ($110$--$170~GHz$). The antenna is fabricated on a seven-layer organic packaging technology. The patches are fabricated on layers 1 and 3 within a shielding cavity formed by closely spaced vias of $< \lambda/20$ pitch. The fabrication technology supports direct chip-level excitation of the antenna using a flip-chip packaging interface, and the design methodology for this feeding approach is outlined in the paper. In the fabricated design, however, a transition to the WR6 metallic waveguide with ($<~1~dB$) insertion loss (IL) is incorporated for feeding. This facilitates alignment and measurement of the structure using external test equipment. The full antenna and transition are integrated in a back-to-back configuration, achieving a measured $10~dB$ return loss bandwidth of more than $60~GHz$ ($110$--$170~GHz$) for the wireless link, thereby covering the entire D-band. To the best of our knowledge, this is the widest antenna bandwidth reported in the same frequency range. The measured peak gain is $8.5~dBi$ (35$^\circ$ H-plane $3~dB$ beamwidth) with a gain variation of $3.5~dBi$ within the operating bandwidth. For the dielectric waveguide configuration, the measured $10~dB$ RL bandwidth also exceeds $60~GHz$, fully encompassing the D-band. The simulated insertion loss coupling into the dielectric waveguide is $3.5~dB$. A 1-meter dielectric waveguide channel fed with the proposed antenna is measured. The overall channel exhibits a total insertion loss of $14.7~dB$, of which a simulated $3.5~dB$ at $140~GHz$ is attributed to the loss of each side that feeds the DWG.

summaries.en: The paper presents a stacked dual-patch antenna on a seven-layer organic packaging platform with chip-level flip-chip excitation (plus a WR6 transition for measurement) that achieves over 60 GHz of 10 dB return-loss bandwidth from 110 to 170 GHz for both wireless and dielectric-waveguide channels, demonstrating ~8.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种用于D波段（110–170 GHz）的超宽带堆叠双贴片天线，基于七层有机封装实现并在无线与介质波导（DWG）两种信道下验证：通过选取贴片尺寸与间距使10 dB回波损耗带宽覆盖整个D波段，天线支持翻片芯片级激励（用于测量另引入WR6金属波导过渡，便于对准与测试），实测无线链路10 dB回波损耗带宽超过60 GHz且峰值增益约8.

title: Compact Slow-Wave Hybrid Magnonics on Ultrahigh-Permittivity Substrates
abstract: Hybrid magnonics based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs) enables strong, broadband magnon-photon coupling, but the centimeter-scale device footprints required at low gigahertz frequencies hinder integration. Here, we demonstrate miniaturized slow-wave hybrid magnonic devices using an ultrahigh-permittivity ceramic substrate ($\varepsilon = 140$). Owing to the inverse-square-root dependence of the SSPP plasma frequency on effective permittivity, the required corrugation finger length is reduced by nearly a factor of four compared with conventional microwave substrates. The ceramic is thick and brittle, and conventional thin-film processes cannot easily pattern thick, low-loss conductors on it. We overcome this challenge with additively manufactured electronics (AME). In a customized AME workflow, a multi-material inkjet printer first prints a dielectric fixture that holds and registers the ceramic. After the ceramic is loaded, the printer prints thick silver SSPP patterns directly onto it. Measurements on six printed devices with different finger lengths confirm the predicted geometry-frequency scaling. Moreover, the enhanced field confinement of the compact SSPP waveguide nearly doubles the magnon-photon coupling strength and yields ultrastrong coupling with $g/f_\mathrm{p} \approx 22\%$. Notably, this performance is achieved using a YIG film whose magnetic volume is more than an order of magnitude smaller than that employed in previous SSPP demonstrations. These results establish AME on ultrahigh-permittivity substrates as a practical route toward compact, strongly coupled hybrid magnonic devices.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates miniaturized slow-wave hybrid magnonic devices using an ultrahigh-permittivity ceramic substrate (ε=140) fabricated via additively manufactured thick silver SSPP patterns, showing near-fourfold reduced corrugation length, scaling-validated device performance, nearly doubled magnon–photon coupling with ultrastrong coupling (g/fp≈22%) using much smaller YIG volume, and establishing AME as a practical route for compact strongly coupled hybrid magnonics.
summaries.zh: 论文基于超高介电常数陶瓷基底（ε=140）实现了微型慢波混合磁子器件，通过增材制造直接在其上打印厚银SSPP图案，验证了近四倍缩短的沟槽指长与几何—频率标度关系，增强了约一倍的磁子—光子耦合并实现超强耦合（g/fp≈22%），同时所用YIG磁性体积比以往SSPP演示小一个数量级以上，从而证明增材制造是通往紧凑强耦合混合磁子学器件的可行路径。

title: N-Polar AlGaN/GaN Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor
abstract: Heterojunction bipolar transistors based on the III-Nitride systems have significantly lower performance than field effect transistors due to challenges associated with p-type doping of the base. N-polar AlGaN/GaN HBTs can overcome these challenges by polarization-induced holes in the base and base-emitter interface. We experimentally demonstrate the first N-polar AlGaN/GaN heterojunction bipolar transistors (HBTs) grown by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy on GaN substrate without emitter regrowth. The HBTs exhibit a peak current gain of approximately 15, peak differential current gain of approximately 18, and emitter-area-normalized peak current densities exceeding 20 kA/cm^2 and 66 kA/cm^2 for emitter areas of 10 x 10 um^2 and 3 x 10 um^2, respectively. The specific contact resistance for base is estimated 1.32 x 10^{-2} this http URL ^2. The open-base breakdown voltage is characterized ~63 V for a 300 nm collector without dielectric passivation. This work lays the foundation for future development of N-polar III-Nitride HBTs for next-generation RF applications.

summaries.en: The paper reports the first experimentally demonstrated N-polar AlGaN/GaN heterojunction bipolar transistors grown by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy on a GaN substrate without emitter regrowth, achieving peak current gain ~15 (differential gain ~18), high emitter-area-normalized current densities, low estimated base contact resistance, and an open-base breakdown voltage around 63 V, enabling groundwork for future N-polar III-nitride HBTs aimed at next-generation RF applications.
summaries.zh: 论文首次实验实现了在GaN衬底上采用等离子体辅助有机分子束外延、且无需重生发射极的N极性AlGaN/GaN异质结双极晶体管，通过获得峰值电流增益约15（微分电流增益约18）、较高的发射极面积归一化电流密度、估计的较低基极接触电阻以及约63 V的开基击穿电压，为面向下一代射频应用的N极性III族氮化物HBT发展奠定基础。

title: A counterexample to the Ho-Hsieh VQCS saturation conjecture
abstract: We show that there exists a 4-qubit state that can be prepared by a variational quantum-classical simulation (VQCS) circuit ansatz containing 3 layers, but not with 2 layers. This disproves the strong form of a conjecture presented by Ho and Hsieh stating that the expressivity of VQCS on $L$ qubits saturates at $L/2$ layers. The weak form of the conjecture concerning the preparation of the ground state remains open.

summaries.en: The paper presents a specific 4-qubit state that a 3-layer variational quantum-classical simulation circuit can prepare but a 2-layer one cannot, thereby refuting Ho and Hsieh’s strong conjecture that VQCS expressivity saturates at L/2 layers, while leaving their weaker ground-state preparation conjecture unresolved.
summaries.zh: 论文给出一个反例：某个4比特量子态可以由包含3层的变分量子-经典仿真（VQCS）电路来制备，但无法由2层来制备，从而推翻Ho和Hsieh提出的强形式猜想——即VQCS在L比特上的表达能力会在L/2层处饱和；而关于基态制备的弱形式猜想仍未解决。

title: Certifying closed labs in device-independent tests of indefinite causality
abstract: Indefinite causal order allows processes in which the order of events is not predetermined, enabling information-processing advantages unattainable with fixed causal structures. A long-standing open problem is whether such processes can be certified without trusting the devices used to demonstrate them, analogous to device-independent certifications of Bell nonlocality. Causal inequalities offer a route towards this goal, since their violation is intended to rule out all definite causal structures. However, fully device-independent certification of indefinite causal order remains elusive. The difficulty lies in the closed laboratories assumption, which requires each party to interact at most once with systems that mediate communication. Without this assumption, ordinary two-way communication can reproduce causal-inequality violations without involving indefinite causal order. Yet an untrusted device could violate the assumption by interacting with the mediating system more than once, while remaining undetected from input-output statistics alone. We address this loophole by embedding a minimal set of additional experimental components into a certification scheme. These elements probabilistically probe the underlying process, enabling the closed laboratories assumption to be validated directly within the protocol. Our framework provides operationally meaningful minimal-assumption tests of indefinite causal order, clarifying its distinction from nonlocality and paving the way for cryptographic and self-testing applications.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a partially device-independent certification scheme for indefinite causal order that fixes the loophole in the closed-laboratories assumption by adding minimal extra components that probabilistically test the mediating process within the protocol, enabling operational minimal-assumption verification distinct from Bell nonlocality.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种用于不可定因果次序的部分设备无关认证方案：通过在协议中嵌入一组最小的额外实验组件来对介导过程进行概率性探测，从而堵住“封闭实验室”假设的关键漏洞，实现可操作的最小假设验证，并澄清其与贝尔非定域性的区别。

title: Ground-State Chiral Quantum Clusters
abstract: Quantum time crystals are states of matter that spontaneously break time translation symmetry, extending the notion of crystalline order to time. While their out-of-equilibrium version has been successfully realized by periodic driving, the equilibrium counterpart remains elusive. Here we introduce "ground-state chiral quantum clusters": self-bound many-body ground states supporting a persistent current. We provide a minimal field theory describing these states, and an exact microscopic realization via the attractive anyonic Lieb-Liniger model on a ring. In the latter, the ground-state density-density correlator exhibits the Talbot effect, with a soliton-like profile that periodically disperses and revives while drifting indefinitely along the ring, realizing persistent motion at equilibrium. Possible experimental probes are discussed.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech)

summaries.en: The paper proposes “ground-state chiral quantum clusters,” self-bound many-body ground states with persistent equilibrium currents, develops a minimal field theory for them, and shows an exact realization in the attractive anyonic Lieb–Liniger model on a ring where density correlations display a Talbot-effect soliton profile that disperses and revives while continuously drifting along the ring.
summaries.zh: 本文提出“基态手性量子簇”，即自束缚多体基态并在平衡下产生持续电流，给出了其最小场论描述，并在环上的吸引型任意子 Lieb–Liniger 模型中给出精确微观实现：其基态密度-密度相关函数呈现塔尔博特效应，表现为类孤子形状周期性展宽与复现，同时在环上不断漂移，从而实现平衡下的持续运动，并讨论了可能的实验探测方案。

title: Quantum State Preparation from Nonreversible Markov Chains via Spectral Filtering
abstract: We develop a framework for preparing and transporting coherent quantum samples of nonreversible Markov chains. Our approach uses spectral filtering to construct state-dependent phase operations, which are combined with fixed-point amplitude amplification to transport quantum states along a sequence of related chains. We study two complementary constructions with different oracle requirements and target states. The first uses coherent access to both forward and time-reversed transitions and targets the stationary quantum sample, with a filtering cost governed by a multiplicative-reversibilization gap. The second requires only forward transitions and selects the leading eigenstate of a flat discriminant, which may differ from the stationary quantum sample; we quantify this bias under additional spectral and reversibility-on-average conditions. For the forward-only construction, we implement the spectral filter using generalized quantum signal processing with a single signal qubit, apart from transition registers and oracle workspace. We establish a common transport procedure and derive error and resource bounds that account for spectral properties, overlaps between successive selected states, and the costs of coherent multi-step transition oracles. Up to logarithmic factors, spectral-filter degrees scale inversely with the square roots of the relevant spectral gaps, while transport introduces an additional inverse-square-root dependence on certified lower bounds on squared overlaps between successive selected states. Our results extend existing nonreversible spectral methods to multistage coherent state transport with controlled approximation errors.

summaries.en: The paper presents a spectral-filtering framework to coherently prepare and transport quantum samples of nonreversible Markov chains using phase operations plus fixed-point amplitude amplification, offering two constructions with different oracle requirements and analyzing error and resource costs tied to spectral gaps, state overlaps, and multi-step transition-oracle complexity.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种利用谱滤波构造相位操作并结合固定点振幅放大的方法，用于对非可逆马尔可夫链的量子样本进行相干制备与传输；作者给出两种在预言机需求上各不相同的实现，并分析误差与资源开销如何由谱隙、相邻所选态的重叠及多步转移预言机成本等因素共同决定。

title: Quantum Control Under Control-Dependent Decoherence
abstract: Decoherence, which arises from the interaction of a quantum system with a typically much larger thermal environment, or bath, poses major challenges to the controllability of quantum systems. The dynamics of such open quantum systems is often represented by Markovian quantum master equations of the Lindblad or Redfield type. These equations describe the dynamics of the open system with a sum of coherent (Hamiltonian) and decoherent (dissipative) contributions. It is often assumed that coherent controls only impact the coherent contribution, while the decoherent contribution is taken to be time- and control-independent. However, the decoherent contribution must also be control-dependent if coupling to a thermal bath is to relax the system to a Gibbs state at thermal equilibrium, which is given in terms of the system's Hamiltonian. In this paper, we investigate the effect of accounting for control-dependent decoherence on coherent control protocols. To this end, we examine the effect of accounting for control-dependent decoherence on the controllability of an open quantum system in the case of a two-level system coupled to a thermal bath. We show that coherent controls wield greater influence on the dynamics of the system than predicted by a Lindblad-type equation that models decoherence as time- and control-independent.

summaries.en: The paper shows that decoherence in open quantum systems is generally control-dependent—needed to relax to a Gibbs state determined by the Hamiltonian—and that including this control-dependent decoherence increases the effective influence of coherent controls compared with common Lindblad models that assume time- and control-independent dissipation.
summaries.zh: 论文指出，在开放量子系统中退相干通常是与控制相关的：为了让系统按由哈密顿量决定的吉布斯态达到热平衡，耗散项必须依赖控制；并且在考虑这种控制相关退相干后，所得到的相干控制对系统动力学的影响会比常见将退相干假设为时间与控制无关的Lindblad模型预测得更强（以两能级与热浴耦合为例）。

title: All-electronic geometric phase gate on Doppler-cooled trapped ions using an axial mode
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of a high-fidelity oscillating magnetic gradient entangling gate on the axial stretch mode of a two-ion crystal in a micro-fabricated surface Paul trap, therefore allowing for mixed-species sympathetic cooling. With only Doppler-cooled $^{171}$Yb$^+$ ions at $\bar{n}$ = 50(5), we achieve Bell-state fidelities far above the relevant fault-tolerant threshold, simplifying transport protocols within a shuttling-based-architecture. The control fields consist only of an oscillating current applied to submerged integrated wires emitting a B-field gradient near-resonant with the axial mode, and resonant microwave pulses at the qubit frequency constituting very low gate calibration overheads. We also demonstrate an adiabatic elimination of spin-motion entanglement (AESE) version of the gate, showcasing significant robustness.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally demonstrates a high-fidelity oscillating-magnetic-gradient geometric phase entangling gate on the axial mode of a two-ion crystal in a microfabricated surface Paul trap using only Doppler-cooled $^{171}$Yb$^+$, achieving Bell-state fidelities well above fault-tolerant thresholds with minimal calibration via integrated-wire current gradients and microwave qubit pulses, and it further shows an adiabatic-elimination (AESE) version with strong robustness.
summaries.zh: 论文在微型表面保留离子阱中，利用仅用多普勒冷却的$^{171}$Yb$^+$实验实现了作用于两离子晶体轴向伸缩模的高保真振荡磁梯度几何相位纠缠门，在相关容错阈值之上获得了很高的贝尔态保真度，并通过埋设集成导线产生接近共振的轴向模磁场梯度与共振微波脉冲实现低校准开销，另外还展示了自旋-运动纠缠消除（AESE）版本并表现出显著鲁棒性。

title: Probing the inner structure of bound states
abstract: We show how constructing a composite particle eigenstate reveals its internal structure. Using quantum subspace expansion (QSE), we optimize states with different sets of operators and use their fidelities with the full QSE state to measure the importance of each added operator type. Taking the scalar meson of the massive Schwinger model as a benchmark, we find that fermion bilinears suffice at large fermion masses. At small masses, two classes of four-fermion operators play important but very different roles: the four fermion operators with two fermions and 2 anti-fermions at small distance give little improvement. In contrast, spatially extended meson-meson operators produce a large gain in state fidelity. Turning to observables, we find that the scalar charge is much more sensitive to the meson-meson operators than e.g. the meson mass. The parton distribution function (PDF) also changes from symmetric to asymmetric about the momentum fraction 1/2, along with the growing importance of meson-meson operators. These results establish QSE as a tool for probing the internal structure of composite particles and connecting it to observable properties.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; High Energy Physics - Lattice (hep-lat)

summaries.en: Using quantum subspace expansion with operator-set dependent optimizations and fidelity comparisons, the paper identifies which operator types reveal the internal structure of bound states, finding for the massive Schwinger model scalar meson that fermion bilinears suffice at large masses while at small masses extended meson-meson operators strongly improve fidelity and crucially affect observables like scalar charge and the PDF’s symmetry/asymmetry.
summaries.zh: 本文通过量子子空间展开（QSE）在不同算符集合下优化复合粒子本征态并用与完整QSE态的保真度进行比较，确定哪些算符类型能够揭示束缚态的内部结构；以大质量Schwinger模型中的标量介子为基准，发现大质量时费米子双线即可， 而在小质量下空间延展的介子-介子算符显著提升保真度并显著影响如标量电荷及PDF在x=1/2附近由对称转为不对称等可观测量。

title: Symmetry-constrained order hierarchy of connected optical responses in a five-level Rydberg-EIT medium
abstract: Determining the connected many-body correlations required for a nonlinear optical response of a given order is a central challenge in interacting open quantum systems. We establish a symmetrybased selection rule for connected optical responses in a driven-dissipative Rydberg-EIT model. Under the specified Lindblad conditions, local phase covariance and zero-probe factorization imply that an n-atom connected contribution to the root optical coherence is forbidden below probe-amplitude order 2n-1. Consequently, optical-response coefficients through fifth order involve at most three-atom connected clusters, without assuming weak interatomic interactions. Direct finite-cluster calculations confirm the predicted lowest allowed orders, while an illustrative Maxwell-propagation calculation shows that triplet contributions can partially oppose pair-induced polarization rotation. Our results establish a rigorous connection between optical perturbation order and the connected many-body sectors that can contribute to it.

summaries.en: In a driven-dissipative five-level Rydberg-EIT medium, the authors derive a symmetry-based selection rule showing that, under Lindblad phase-covariance and zero-probe factorization, an n-atom connected contribution to the root optical coherence is forbidden below probe order 2n−1, so up to fifth order only connected clusters involving at most three atoms contribute and finite-cluster calculations and example Maxwell propagation confirm the resulting lowest allowed orders and partial cancellation effects.
summaries.zh: 作者在受驱耗散的五能级Rydberg-EIT体系中给出基于对称性的选择定则：在满足Lindblad相位协变与零探测因子化条件下，根介质光学相干的n原子连通贡献在探测幅度阶低于2n−1时被禁止，因此到五阶的光学响应系数最多只来自三原子连通簇，有限簇计算与示例性的Maxwell传播也验证了最低允许阶及三体贡献对由二体引起极化旋转的部分抵消效应。

title: Exact approach to double- and triple-excitation bound state in open quantum systems
abstract: The determination of multiple-excitation bound state in open quantum systems is of broad interest in quantum physics. While the emergence of double- or triple-excitation bound state has been demonstrated in certain specific situations, their universality and exact solvability remain elusive. In this work, we present an exact approach to the double- or triple-excitation dynamics for interacting quantum emitters coupled to environment by deriving a closed equation. By this exact equation, we identify the critical condition for the emergence of double- or triple-excitation bound state, as well as its relationship to the single-excitation one. Our study not only clearly demonstrates the universality of double- or triple-excitation bound state in open quantum emitter systems, but also reveals the possibility of mediating inter-emitter interactions via multiple-excitation bound states.

summaries.en: The paper develops an exact closed-equation approach for double- and triple-excitation dynamics of interacting quantum emitters in open systems, identifying the critical conditions for such bound states and their universal relationship to single-excitation bound states while showing they can mediate inter-emitter interactions.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种用于开放量子系统中相互作用量子发射体双激发与三激发动力学的精确封闭方程方法，确定双/三激发束缚态出现的临界条件及其与单激发束缚态的普适关联，并揭示多激发束缚态还能介导发射体之间的相互作用。

title: A machine learning architecture for scaling of holographic quantum circuits
abstract: We describe an architecture and workflow for learning and generalizing the syntax and parameters of holographic quantum circuits (HQCs), which are natural quantum circuit analogs of classical tensor networks. An HQC uses mid-circuit measurements and resets on a small subset of "physical" qubits whose measurement outcomes become correlated through coupling with a register of persistent "ancilla" qubits, analogous to the physical and bond indices of a tensor network. Hence, an HQC with fixed qubit resources can efficiently generate samples from a large quantum state, and adding qubits to the HQC ansatz has the effect of exponentially increasing the effective bond dimension. Our machine learning approach provides mechanisms for harnessing both features of HQCs by extrapolating the syntax (e.g., a sequence of gates, measurements, and resets) and parameters (e.g., the angles appearing in single-qubit rotations) from a dataset of HQCs to longer or more expressive HQCs. We demonstrate the methodology and its performance on an analytically solvable dataset formed by a vector-valued generalization of the W-state. Finally, we provide an outlook for usage of the methodology for scaling the effective bond dimensions of HQCs in quantum simulation.

summaries.en: The paper presents a machine-learning workflow that learns and extrapolates the gate-measurement-reset syntax and rotation parameters of holographic quantum circuits to scale them to more expressive states with exponentially increased effective bond dimensions, validated on an analytically solvable vector-valued W-state dataset and discussed for quantum simulation.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种机器学习工作流，通过从数据集中学习并外推全息量子电路的门-测量-重置“语法”和单比特旋转等参数，使其在不增加物理资源的情况下扩展到更具表现力的电路，从而实现等效键维数的指数级增长，并在解析可解的矢量值W态数据集上验证了方法效果，且展望其用于量子模拟中的键维数扩展。

title: QuOptLab: Advancing Quantum Optics Experiments with an AI Agent
abstract: Recent advances in AI-assisted theoretical research suggest that AI agents can contribute to research-level problems. Whether they can also advance experimental research by conducting experiments, analyzing the results, and proposing better experimental designs remains an open question. To address this question, we build a simulated quantum optics laboratory and integrate it with an AI agent in QuOptLab. The laboratory includes optical instruments, a robotic arm, and cameras, enabling the agent to carry out and iteratively refine experiments. We consider two complementary tasks: thin-film thickness measurement in free-space optics and edge-coupler design in integrated photonics. In the thin-film thickness measurement task, the agent repeatedly analyzes measurement results and revises its measurement method, including calibration and data analysis, reducing thickness-estimation error from 7.13 to 0.066~nm$^2$ over six epochs in a classical-interference run. For edge-coupler design, the agent iteratively proposes structural modifications, evaluates the resulting coupling performance, and uses the feedback to guide subsequent revisions, increasing simulated coupling efficiency from 85.81% to 91.98%.

summaries.en: QuOptLab builds a simulated quantum optics laboratory integrated with an AI agent to iteratively run and refine experiments, achieving near-precision thin-film thickness measurements and improving integrated-photonics edge-coupler coupling efficiency via closed-loop analysis and design updates.
summaries.zh: QuOptLab构建了集成AI智能体的模拟量子光学实验室，通过闭环分析与迭代改进实验方法，既将薄膜厚度测量误差从7.

title: Beyond Classical Minimax Rates: Quantum Sampling in Gradient-Based Simulation Optimization
abstract: We study gradient-based search for a class of convex simulation optimization problems with gradients estimated from noisy outputs. With independent outputs, the optimal classical convergence rate for the expected objective gap is of order $O(N^{-2/3})$, where $N$ is the query budget. We apply quantum mean estimation to paired finite differences and progressively increase their estimation accuracy as the perturbations shrink, improving the convergence rate to $O(N^{-4/3})$. Furthermore, we show that coupling nearby evaluations improves the classical and quantum convergence rates to $O(N^{-2/(3-\kappa)})$ and $O(N^{-4/(3-\kappa)})$, respectively, where $\kappa\in[0,1]$ describes the variance reduction in paired outputs. Thus, quantum estimation halves the accuracy exponent in query complexity across coupling orders. Moreover, we establish matching lower bounds and show that these accuracy exponents are minimax optimal for fixed decision dimension, even when query locations and batch sizes are adaptive. Reconstruction from feasible differences retains the exponents when every simulation query must be feasible and accommodates boundary optima.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Optimization and Control (math.OC); Computation (stat.CO)

summaries.en: The paper shows that in convex gradient-based simulation optimization with noisy outputs, quantum mean estimation applied to progressively refined paired finite differences improves the expected objective-gap convergence rate from O(N^{-2/3}) classically to O(N^{-4/3}), with further coupling of nearby evaluations yielding O(N^{-2/(3-κ)}) and O(N^{-4/(3-κ)}) rates (κ∈[0,1]) that are minimax optimal via matching lower bounds, including adaptive queries and feasible-difference reconstruction.
summaries.zh: 论文研究在噪声输出的凸仿真优化中用基于梯度的搜索进行参数优化：在独立输出下经典期望目标间隙的最优收敛率为 O(N^{-2/3})，而对成对有限差分应用量子均值估计并随扰动缩小逐步提高估计精度后可将收敛率提升到 O(N^{-4/3})，进一步通过耦合相邻评估可把经典与量子收敛率分别改进为 O(N^{-2/(3-κ)}) 和 O(N^{-4/(3-κ)})（κ∈[0,1]表示成对输出的方差降低），并借助匹配下界证明这些精度指数在固定决策维度下在自适应查询位置与批大小等情形下也是极小极大最优，且在所有仿真查询必须可行并允许边界最优时，基于可行差分的重建仍保持这些指数。

title: Rydberg Constraint Ensembles for Nonnative Binary Optimization
abstract: Rydberg blockade can exclude the configuration that minimizes a binary objective. We expand its finite penalties into a weighted ensemble of exclusion graphs. The full ensemble preserves the ground energy, and the interactions remaining on each graph set its local detunings. In simulations of two coupled squares, reversing a target coupling leaves the single-site energy slopes at uniform occupation unchanged, yet a collective mode of the residual interactions switches the favored diagonals from aligned to opposed. On 32 held-out twelve-site targets, the simulated probability of recovering a ground state in 128 shots averages 69.82\% with residual detunings and 24.31\% with a tuned uniform pulse. By scoring the pooled samples under the original objective, we can use these native layouts to search for ground states of a Hamiltonian that none implements alone.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a weighted ensemble of Rydberg-blockade exclusion graphs that preserves the original ground-state energy while allowing the remaining interactions to tune local detunings, enabling simulations on coupled-square systems and 32 held-out twelve-site targets where pooled native layouts improve ground-state recovery compared with a tuned uniform pulse.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种将Rydberg阻塞的有限惩罚扩展为加权排除图集合的方法：该集合能保持原始目标函数的基态能量不变，同时让各图上剩余相互作用来调节局部失谐，从而在耦合方阵与32个未参与训练的十二点目标上实现更好的基态恢复概率，并通过按原目标对合并样本评分，利用这些单独未实现的“原生布局”去搜索另一个哈密顿量的基态。

title: Thermal state preparation with shallow quantum circuits
abstract: Preparing thermal states on noisy quantum hardware requires circuits that remain shallow at low temperatures. Even when accurate classical state representations are available, compiling them into suitable circuits can be costly. We introduce PP-VarQITE, combining Pauli propagation with variational quantum imaginary-time evolution to determine circuit parameters entirely classically, with target temperatures encoded in the angles of a fixed circuit architecture. In numerical studies of Ising and frustrated Heisenberg models, we recover low-temperature energies and correlations using up to 100 qubits. Across the frustrated chain and two-dimensional lattice, our circuits are approximately two to ten times shallower than the lowest-depth circuits from sequential tensor-network compilation. These shallow circuits enable us to prepare a 48-site frustrated chain and a $7\times7$ Ising lattice using 96 and 98 qubits on the Quantinuum Helios trapped-ion quantum processor. We reproduce the development of dimer order and lattice-wide correlations from high to low temperatures, with the lattice circuits requiring at most 42 two-qubit layers. Through classical circuit design, we demonstrate low-temperature state preparation at circuit sizes beyond the practical reach of statevector simulation.

summaries.en: The paper presents PP-VarQITE, a classical parameter-determination method that uses Pauli propagation with variational quantum imaginary-time evolution and a fixed shallow circuit to prepare low-temperature thermal states on noisy hardware, achieving up to 100-qubit studies and demonstrating 48-site and 7×7 lattice thermal-state preparation on a Quantinuum Helios trapped-ion device with highly reduced circuit depth.
summaries.zh: 本文提出PP-VarQITE方法，结合保利传播与变分量子虚时间演化，并采用固定的浅层电路结构，通过全程经典方式确定电路参数来制备低温热态；数值研究中在最多100量子比特上恢复低温能量与关联，并在Quantinuum Helios困囚离子量子处理器上用96和98量子比特分别制备48位受挫链与7×7伊辛晶格热态，同时复现从高温到低温的二聚序与晶格范围关联且所需两体门层数最多为42层，从而在超出态矢仿真可达规模的电路尺寸上实现低温态制备。

title: Electron spin relaxation and coherence times of silicon vacancies in 4H-SiC
abstract: Color defect centers carrying electron spins in solid crystals like diamond and silicon carbide (SiC) are promising candidates for qubits and quantum sensors, with SiC material being particularly interesting due to its compatibility with the existing semiconductor technology. Here we investigated the electron spin properties of silicon vacancy centers (V1 and V2) both electron spin $S = 3/2$ in 4H-SiC in the temperature range $T=80-300$~K using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR). The EPR spectrum shows central and satellite lines, where the former ones originate from V1 and V2 centers, as well as from unknown defect center X. The analysis of continuous wave EPR measurements revealed a spin concentration of $c_{\mathrm{V1}}=1.47\pm0.3\times10^{14}$, $c_{\mathrm{V2}}=5.6\pm1.12\times10^{13}$ and $c_{\mathrm{X}}=1.03\pm0.21\times10^{13}$ spins/cm$^{3}$. Additionally, electron spin coherence $T_2$ and relaxation times $T_1$ have been measured on the central and on the satellite spectral lines, resulting in longer $T_1$ and $T_2$ for the satellite transition, compared to the central one, with maximum values of $42.8\pm1.3$~ms and $0.708\pm0.004$~ms respectively at $T=80$~K. We reveal, that decoherence is mainly caused by nuclear and electron spin diffusion.

summaries.en: Using electron paramagnetic resonance on 4H-SiC silicon vacancy centers (V1 and V2) with electron spin S=3/2 across 80–300 K, the authors quantify defect spin concentrations, measure longer spin-relaxation T1 and coherence T2 times for satellite transitions than for central ones (max T1=42.

title: Quantum Community Detection for Data Analysis
abstract: Community detection offers an alternative to conventional methods for data analysis tasks such as feature selection and clustering, and detecting communities with quantum algorithms is a promising avenue for quantum speedup. We investigate quantum spectral community detectors, such as the modularity-matrix algorithm deteQt, in pipelines for both tasks. We first generalise deteQt to multiple communities by recursive bisection, and show that it recovers planted communities, and hence redundant features, in synthetic and small datasets. We then propose projeQt, which applies a spectral filter to the encoded modularity matrix through the quantum singular value transformation, retaining higher-order eigenvectors that deteQt does not use. projeQt acts on the generalised modularity matrix and extracts several communities at once, without recursion, by k-means clustering of a Gram matrix built from quantum state overlaps. On MNIST we demonstrate both pipelines, selecting informative pixels and classifying images directly by clustering, and find them competitive with standard community detectors.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)

summaries.en: The paper studies quantum spectral community-detection algorithms—generalizing deteQt via recursive bisection for multi-community feature selection and proposing projeQt using quantum singular value transformation and k-means on a Gram matrix—to recover planted communities and extract informative features and communities from MNIST, achieving competitive performance on both pixel selection and direct clustering-based classification.
summaries.zh: 该论文研究量子谱社区检测算法：通过递归二分对deteQt进行多社区推广用于特征选择与恢复潜伏社区，并提出projeQt，借助量子奇异值变换对广义模块度矩阵进行谱过滤并在由量子态重叠构建的Gram矩阵上做k-means聚类，从而从MNIST中提取信息性像素与社区并在像素选择与直接聚类式分类两项任务上表现具有竞争力。

title: Large-Scale Streaming Portfolio Optimization with Pauli Correlation Encoding
abstract: Classical portfolio construction over large asset universes is a combinatorial selection problem that existing heuristics do not solve well at scale. Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) addresses this by representing the underlying clustering problem with far fewer qubits than one per asset, and a prior study showed it is competitive with classical methods on a single historical snapshot. This paper moves beyond that static test to a streaming deployment, in which the correlation structure and the portfolio are both re-estimated on a rolling basis, as a live rebalancing system would actually operate. We introduce two streaming variants -- PCE itself and a joint multi-cut variant, dPCE -- and evaluate both against a Buy & Hold baseline across window lengths, portfolio sizes up to several thousand assets, risk-aversion and transaction-cost settings, and measurement-shot budgets. Streaming PCE and dPCE consistently outperform the passive baseline, including during a market downturn where both lose money but PCE loses markedly less -- evidence that the method's value is not confined to rising markets. PCE also proves the more practical choice at scale, since dPCE's resource requirements and its sensitivity to rebalancing frequency both grow faster with portfolio size. We further report which operational choices -- rebalancing cadence, shot budget, and transaction-cost awareness -- matter most for a real deployment, and which matter less than commonly assumed.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Computational Engineering, Finance, and Science (cs.CE); Portfolio Management (q-fin.PM)

summaries.en: The paper evaluates Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) and a related dPCE method for streaming portfolio optimization by repeatedly re-estimating correlations and rebalancing over rolling windows, finding they outperform a Buy-and-Hold baseline across large asset universes and varied risk and transaction-cost settings, including during market downturns, while PCE is more scalable and less sensitive to rebalancing frequency than dPCE.
summaries.zh: 本文将帕uli关联编码（PCE）及其联合多切变体 dPCE 用于流式投资组合优化，通过滚动窗口反复重估相关性并进行再平衡，结果表明在大规模资产集与不同风险偏好和交易成本设置下它们始终优于买入并持有基线，即使在市场下跌时也能显著减少损失；同时 PCE 在可扩展性和对再平衡频率的敏感性方面优于 dPCE，并进一步分析再平衡节奏、镜头预算与交易成本感知等操作选择对部署影响的大小。

title: Exploiting SU(2) Symmetry for Efficient Quantum State Preparation of Matrix Product States
abstract: Quantum computing offers a promising route to simulating strongly correlated systems, particularly for dynamical and spectral quantities whose classical computation can become prohibitively expensive. Fault-tolerant algorithms for these tasks, including real-time dynamics and phase estimation, assume efficient preparation of the initial many-body state, making state preparation an important bottleneck. Matrix product states obtained classically with the density matrix renormalization group can be compiled sequentially into fault-tolerant circuits. We exploit non-Abelian spin SU(2) symmetry in this compilation. By the Wigner-Eckart theorem, only the reduced tensors, which carry the variational information, need generic unitary synthesis. The magnetic structure is restored by Clebsch-Gordan transformations with analytically known angles. We benchmark the method on representative strongly correlated models, including the one-dimensional Hubbard model, quasi-one-dimensional Hubbard geometries, and Anderson impurity models, and perform fault-tolerant resource estimates using the Toffoli count as the primary cost metric. Across the systems considered, exploiting non-Abelian SU(2) symmetry reduces the Toffoli cost roughly threefold relative to U(1)-adapted compilation and by more than an order of magnitude relative to the standard dense compilation method. These results demonstrate how non-Abelian symmetries can substantially reduce the cost of transferring classically tractable many-body ground states to quantum computers, facilitating their use in quantum dynamics and energy estimation.

summaries.en: The paper presents a fault-tolerant quantum-circuit compilation method for preparing classically obtained matrix product states by exploiting non-Abelian SU(2) symmetry via the Wigner-Eckart theorem, reducing Toffoli gate costs by about threefold versus U(1) compilation and over an order of magnitude versus dense synthesis across several correlated models.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种利用非阿贝尔SU(2)对称性的故障容错电路编译方法，用于将经典得到的矩阵乘积态高效转化为量子态制备，并借助维格纳-埃克特定理仅合成携带变分信息的约化张量、再用已知的克莱布什-戈登变换恢复磁结构，结果在多个强关联系统中以Toffoli门数为主要指标，相比U(1)编译约降低三倍、相较密集合成降低超过一个数量级，表明SU(2)对称性可显著降低将经典可处理基态导入量子计算以用于动力学与能量估计的成本。

title: Class-resolved sifting for quantum key distribution with photon pairs hyperentangled in polarization and transverse spatial variables
abstract: Photon pairs hyperentangled in polarization and transverse spatial variables can carry two key bits per pair in entanglement-based quantum key distribution. We develop class-resolved sifting for such sources: every detected pair is assigned to a class according to which degrees of freedom were measured in compatible bases, and error and key rates are estimated separately in each class. Applied to previously reported data from a two-crystal spontaneous parametric down-conversion source read out in intermediate fractional-Fourier planes, the method recovers the key yield of independent sifting and turns the comparison between classes into a quantitative consistency test for cross-dependencies between the two degrees of freedom. The measured dependence lies below the spatial-polarization coupling predicted for the source, at the edge of the present statistical sensitivity. Resolving the data by polarization-analyzer setting, we find an approximately twofold dependence of the spatial error on the polarization setting in one readout arm, attributable to the measurement apparatus rather than to the source and relevant to basis-dependent side channels. We compare the hyperentangled protocol with a single 4-dimensional system measured in two mutually unbiased bases. Fundamentally, both yield the same key per detected pair and obey the same entropic bound, but they differ in their tensor-product structure: hyperentanglement factors the bases into separate two-outcome measurements, which are simpler to implement and allow errors to be attributed to each degree of freedom, whereas a single variable gives access to non-product bases that can increase the noise tolerance. For the present source, whose polarization coherence is limited by partial which-crystal erasure, a single-variable spatial encoding would yield more key only if its four-outcome readout kept the symbol error within a few percent.

summaries.en: The paper introduces class-resolved sifting for hyperentangled photon-pair QKD that separately estimates error and key rates per measurement class, using reanalyzed data to reveal low spatial–polarization dependence limited by sensitivity and basis-dependent apparatus-induced spatial errors, and compares the hyperentangled protocol to a single four-dimensional system showing equivalent key yield and entropic bounds but different tensor-product structures and noise tolerance.
summaries.zh: 本文提出面向偏振与横向空间双自由度超纠缠光子对的量子密钥分发（QKD）“按类别分辨”的筛选方法，分别在各测量类别中估计误码率与密钥率，并对既有数据再分析显示空间–偏振耦合依赖性较弱且受统计敏感度限制，同时发现与偏振设置相关的空间误差主要来自测量装置而非源，并将超纠缠方案与单个四维系统在两种互为无偏的基下的方案进行比较：两者在每探测对的密钥率与熵界上等价，但由于张量积结构不同而在噪声容限与误差归因方式上存在差异。

title: Robust growth of $α$-tantalum on sapphire at room temperature using atomically thin titanium seed layer
abstract: Tantalum (Ta) based superconducting circuits have attracted attention for their low microwave loss. However, reproducible growth of high-quality $\alpha$-phase Ta films remains challenging because film properties are highly sensitive to growth conditions. We present a robust, room-temperature route for $\alpha$-Ta growth on sapphire substrates using an ultrathin Ti seed layer, which significantly widens the accessible deposition parameter space. We compare this approach to Ta films grown at high temperature without a seed layer and at room temperature with a Nb seed. We assess films using structural and surface characterization and quantify microwave loss with coplanar-waveguide (CPW) resonators measured in the quantum regime. We obtain two-level-system (TLS)-limited quality factors comparable to the state of the art for Ta-on-sapphire CPW resonators with similar geometries. In addition, temperature-dependent measurements reveal that high-temperature-grown films and films subjected to extended buffered-oxide etch treatment exhibit additional temperature activated loss, highlighting the role of growth route and post-processing in microwave performance. Our results establish ultrathin seed-layer engineering as a reliable alternative route to reproducible, low-loss $\alpha$-Ta films and motivate closer study of the interfacial mechanisms that govern Ta phase formation.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a robust room-temperature method to grow low-microwave-loss α-phase tantalum on sapphire by using an ultrathin titanium seed layer, enabling reproducible films with TLS-limited quality factors comparable to state of the art and revealing that growth route and post-processing strongly affect temperature-activated losses through structural and CPW resonator characterization.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种通过在蓝宝石上引入超薄钛种子层来在室温下稳定生长低微波损耗α相钽薄膜的方法，使得可重复获得与同类器件相当、受TLS限制的高品质因数结果，并通过结构表征与CPW谐振器量化发现：生长路径及后处理会显著影响温度活化损耗，提示界面机制对相形成起关键作用。
